entities.summary: Alois Joseph Windisch was an Austrian officer, finally a Major General in the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany during World War II. Along with Friedrich Franek, he was one of only two recipients of both the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross and the Knight's Cross of the Military Order of Maria Theresa, the highest military honour of Austria-Hungary.
